title: Command-Line Calculator
objective: Build an interactive calculator that supports common arithmetic operations and validates user input.
skills: Parse operands without panicking on malformed input.
Support add, subtract, multiply, and divide.
Handle division by zero and unknown operations.
Separate parsing, calculation, and display into functions.
